Freight services is the largest revenue line at $442,530 (45% of revenue), followed by warehousing ($233,580) and customs brokerage ($199,950). Labour is the biggest cost driver — direct payroll plus subcontracted labour total $397,490, roughly half of reported expenses — with administrative overhead ($126,610) and fuel/energy ($104,390) the next largest items.

**One issue worth flagging:** the expense lines don't add up to the stated total. Summing the eight expense items gives **$841,550**, not $797,780 — a $43,770 difference. Using the correct expense total, operating profit would be **$141,900** (~14% margin), not $185,670. The revenue lines do sum correctly to $983,450, so the error is in the expense total (and the profit figure derived from it). Since the report is unaudited and prepared from the port services ledger, I'd recommend re-checking the expense tally before relying on the profit figure.
